final: WITH patient_avg AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory), kept AS (SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, o.avg_hgb AS overall_avg FROM patient_avg p CROSS JOIN overall_avg o WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.avg_hgb), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS avg_hgb FROM kept) SELECT k.ID, k.avg_hgb, k.avg_hgb - k.overall_avg AS above_overall, k.avg_hgb - a.avg_hgb AS kept_mean_difference FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_avg a ORDER BY kept_mean_difference DESC LIMIT 10
